role: Independent reviewer, not author of either M3S camera/reference component
scope: Source review, 13 scoped authored tests, source/hash/denominator checks and separate numerical residual/pooled-OOF recomputation from frozen actual receipts; no repeated inference or geometric fitting

tests.evidenceType: Authored structural/formula falsification tests at final component SHAs, not road-quality certification

posthocPooledOOF.status: Posthoc derived diagnostic, not preregistered variant, new threshold, new camera authority or quality evidence
posthocPooledOOF.rationale: Applying whole-image coverage floors separately to alternating half-cell folds can reject spatial coverage even when heldout residual agreement is strong. Therefore both-fold pass counts alone cannot identify residual failure.
posthocPooledOOF.construction: For each pair and model kind, verify the two saved holdout index sets are disjoint and their union is every final control point exactly once. Pool only frozen out-of-fold predictions; never train or select a new model. Recompute original count/support/spatial floors on the full heldout population.
posthocPooledOOF.nearRotationIncomparability: 98 historical near-rotation pairs use residual criterion1.3px, whereas saved F/H diagnostics use1.8px. Pooled acceptance is not a same-threshold replacement for the historical camera guard.
posthocPooledOOF.residualMetricIncomparability: F uses epipolar point-to-line residual; H uses image transfer error. A shared numerical threshold1.8px does not make these two residual metrics or physical hypotheses equivalent.
posthocPooledOOF.interpretation: For 25 city pairs rejected by the pose guard at the same1.8px residual criterion, both pooled F/H support image consistency out of fold. This does not establish a static world, correct camera pose, safe association or true approach. The physical cause of disagreement remains unproven. All pooled support floors pass on stopped turn/low-speed clips; remaining pooled failures are spatial span, not low residual support.

referenceEvidence.limits: Only1 of24 actual roles has synchronized reference endpoints; six additional proxies are counterfactual, not executed measurements. Cuboid vertices include hidden/empty geometry and are not stable visible material-point truth. No relabeling or recall correction is justified.

disposition: Diagnostic tools verified within scope. Product remains NOT_READY for approach recall, physical metres, mobile realtime or navigation. Keep12 frozen misses and old scores unchanged; no warnings authorized by this audit.
